metadata.title: When one lucky kill makes you question if Valorant is just messing with you
metadata.description:
That one kill I did NOT plan but somehow landed.
Valorant logic: broke but still funny.
Watch me accidentally flex like I meant to do that.

Who else lives for these weird clutch moments?

Smash like if your aim ever ghosted but you still got the kill!

#valorant #gaming #luckykill #funnyclips #shorts
